programme.title: 家有囍事2009

programme.title: 长空之王

programme.title: 旺角监狱
To Live and Die in Mongkok
programme.desc: 辉(张家辉 饰) 是仁义社的杀手，旺角是仁义社的地盘为尽江湖手足情，辉便代替兄弟箭猪(韦家雄 饰)去斩杀廿多名黑道中人当年往逮捕细辉的探员枪王余 (廖启智 饰)碰到他，吓得屁滚尿流，连警枪都跌了本来，辉要置他于死地，但讲道义的细辉，见枪王余这样可怜，放他一马，却反被枪王余在他背后轰了一枪，不单受伤，还被拘捕下狱三十年可是，辉亦因此成为仁义社的英雄，旺角的传奇！出狱后，辉已和社会脱节，回到面目全非的旺角，差点连回家也不懂受精神分裂症影响，他以为永远也逃不出旺角，就像置身于监狱一样在旺角的黑道上，他出手救了来自内地的一对姊妹，其中妹妹是弱智的，却惹来不少麻烦 好不容易回到旺角老家，发现已年迈母亲患上老人痴呆症，连自己儿子也认不到...有一天，辉母突然清醒与辉相认，却于同一天逝世 辉为营救这对落难姊妹，招来了杀身之祸，黑白两道狂追猛打...

programme.title: 不日成婚 2
Ready O/R Rot

programme.title: 第一炉香
Love After Love

programme.title: OMG! 阿妈有喜
OMG! Mom's Big News

programme.title: 海关战线

programme.title: 破风

programme.title: 湄公河行动

programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 54
programme.desc: Albi (Samuel Zylgwyn) is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza (Rachquel Nesia), at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia (Faradilla Yoshi), Albi's wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.title: 型男大主厨
Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 早餐中国第五季
Breakfast In China S5

programme.title: 两岸一味第一季&第二季
The Flavourful Link Across the Strait S1 & S2
programme.desc: 以街头巷尾的民间味道为联结，追溯两岸美食的中华渊源，讲述两岸故事，共鸣情感与文化六大主题版块，30种两岸吃食，60组人文故事，用两岸一脉共生的食之味，展现两岸一根同源的人情味，讲述两岸饮食的人间烟火，追寻中华民族的味觉乡愁

programme.title: 幸福房屋事件簿
Haunted House For Sale
programme.desc: 房仲业务安琪突然得知失联多年的父亲留了一间房子给她，不过却始终找不到父亲，房子空置许久，还传出有游民在里面暴毙就在此时，安琪接下了公司凶宅专案的任务，在她处理一桩桩事故屋的过程中，她逐渐打听到了父亲的下落Real estate agent Angel suddenly discovers that her long-lost father has left her a house. However, her father is nowhere to be found, and the house has been left vacant for a long time, rumoured to have vagrants dying inside. Just then, Angel is tasked to sell her companys haunted houses. As she deals with each case, she gradually learns about her fathers whereabouts

programme.title: Over Australia Season 1
programme.desc: From the vast, dry plains of the interior come some of Australia's most recognized imagery, such as the monolithic red rock of Uluru and the bounding red kangaroo. But how did the arid center of the continent come to be?

programme.title: Macaque Island Season 1
programme.desc: Stand back when a brawl erupts after the Street Troop finds the Hill Troop on their turf. Assess Matnoor's poor parenting skills, see alpha wannabe Ajit make his move, then cool off as a heat wave pushes everyone to share the wealth in the forest.

programme.title: After the Wildfires
programme.desc: Examine fire's pivotal role in shaping Australia's natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020's brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continent's wildlife.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 2
programme.desc: Deal with duelling duckling roundups and find out if vet Karina calls in specialists to treat koala Spike's leg fracture. Get to the bottom of stomach issues plaguing baby echidnas Ping and Pong, and meet koala Jarrah, who seems to have lost his way.

programme.title: Becoming Orangutan Season 1
programme.desc: Welcome baby orangutan Topan, an orphan in need of a surrogate mom. Watch her learning journey in nursery school while her fellow students move through junior, senior, and wild-immersion schools. Meanwhile, 16-year-old Kasper preps for graduation.

programme.title: Becoming Orangutan Season 1
programme.desc: Observe blossoming friendships and interspecies bonds in nursery school, and peek inside a bromance among junior-school buds Valentino, Yutris and Madara. See distractible Beni lean into his love of food and get a beating from a more-senior pupil.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 1
programme.desc: With real-life dueling dragons, giant sumo-wrestling beetles, street-fighting monkeys, and sea turtles that play king of the hill on top of another sea turtle, Southeast Asia boasts a wide range of wildlife warriors.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal Season 2
programme.desc: Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal Season 2
programme.desc: Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

programme.desc: A Labrador cross and its partner help prevent ecological disaster in Canada, a Lagotto Romagnolo unearths a rare delicacy in Washington forests, and a Belgian malinois team tracks down the critically endangered geometric tortoise to save the species.

programme.title: Over Australia Season 1
programme.desc: Created by titanic forces and spanning 3,700 km along the eastern edge of Australia, the Great Dividing Range separates two very different worlds. Aerial footage and intimate studies reveal how species survive and thrive in this mountain home.

programme.title: Becoming Orangutan Season 1
programme.desc: Welcome baby orangutan Topan, an orphan in need of a surrogate mom. Watch her learning journey in nursery school while her fellow students move through junior, senior, and wild-immersion schools. Meanwhile, 16-year-old Kasper preps for graduation.

programme.title: Becoming Orangutan Season 1
programme.desc: Observe blossoming friendships and interspecies bonds in nursery school, and peek inside a bromance among junior-school buds Valentino, Yutris and Madara. See distractible Beni lean into his love of food and get a beating from a more-senior pupil.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 2
programme.desc: Contend with a flood of abandoned koala joeys, then join vet nurse Nick on a hunt for natural remedies to treat a wallaby's gut ailment. Ponder options for a baby bat stuck in a tree and look on as vet Karina operates on a barn owl's fractured wing.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal Season 2
programme.desc: Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal Season 2
programme.desc: Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 1
programme.desc: The USA is big on flash and spectacle. Bighorn rams rattle the mountaintops. Brown bears battle, desperate to fatten up for winter. Sharp-tailed grouse shake their tail-feathers on the dance floor. Wild stallions rumble with beauty and grace.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks Season 1
programme.desc: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But it's not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. It's actually a diver's paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

programme.title: Deep in the Heart
programme.desc: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star State's landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas' unique habitats.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1
programme.desc: A young lion cub must survive as his family is torn apart; two adolescent leopard cubs must fend for themselves after they are abandoned, and a young adult blackbuck must risk life and limb as he tries to secure his first mating.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1
programme.desc: Rajan is the powerful alpha male who sits at the head of an unusually large troop. He has done well to sustain such a big group, but the future doesn't look so bright. There are more mouths to feed, and yet his jungle home is shrinking.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1
programme.desc: Nestled on the edge of the ancient city of Jodhpur, the luxurious Temple Gardens are home to a huge troop of Hanuman Langurs, who enjoy a peaceful life of bounty. But the troop has a strict hierarchy.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1
programme.desc: In the hot forest of Southern India, a female King Cobra is on a mission: to find a mate, find food, and lay eggs before the monsoon arrives.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1
programme.desc: In southern India, the summer is a challenge for Asian elephants who must drink every day. As things dry up, Anura, the matriarch, leads her herd to a distant watering hole. But will she succeed in getting her 3-month-old grandson there in time?

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs Season 1
programme.desc: Dogs around the world come to the rescue in surprising ways. Some search for survivors when disaster strikes or rescue animals from poachers and wildlife traffickers. Others help us in times of troubleboth on land and in the water.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs Season 1
programme.desc: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes, a sprocker spaniel whose sense of smell is saving imperilled water voles, and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africa's most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs Season 1
programme.desc: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teacher's pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs Season 1
programme.desc: A blind woman has found a new lease on life thanks to her canine running mate, a Jack Russell works as a super-nanny to a surprising array of species, and a team of dogs in Kenya are on daily patrol protecting endangered rhinos from poachers.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs Season 1
programme.desc: A Labrador cross and its partner help prevent ecological disaster in Canada, a Lagotto Romagnolo unearths a rare delicacy in Washington forests, and a Belgian malinois team tracks down the critically endangered geometric tortoise to save the species.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdom's most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earth's fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeon's internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Deploy biochemical weaponry with nature's most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bow down to one of nature's most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

programme.title: In for the Kill
programme.desc: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

programme.title: Hala 3
programme.desc: Remy Ishak mengembara ke tempat tempat menarik di Malaysia dengan menaiki motosikalnya. Sampai disimpang tiga dia akan mengikut gerak hatinya dan akan memilih satu jalan untuk diterokai.

programme.title: Kembara Chef Wan 2022
programme.desc: Ikuti Chef Wan menjelajah dan menerokai adat, budaya, makanan dan warisan negara Timur Tengah.

programme.title: Cik Misi 123
programme.desc: Oya berjaya mendapatkan sebuah rumah sewa dan mendiaminya bersama rakan-rakan terdekat. Mika tidak pasti jika dia mahu menyambung semula pengajiannya. Umai ada rancangan lain untuk dirinya.

programme.title: Konsert Kilauan Emas Selebriti
programme.desc: Bersama hos, Raja Azura & Keanu Azman, serta Datuk Yusry Abdul Halim & Jihan Muse sebagai juri tetap, saksikan 10 barisan lagenda seni beraksi setiap minggu bagi merebut gelaran juara & memberi sumbangan.

programme.title: Spotlight Kilauan Emas Selebriti
programme.desc: Post Talk Show bersama Zarul Umbrella mengajak penonton menyelami kisah di sebalik pentas menerusi sembang santai bersama pemenang mingguan, juri dan penerima manfaat CSR.

programme.title: Mat Bond Malaya
programme.desc: Dalam komedi romantik gelap ini, seorang lelaki biasa yang mengimpikan untuk menjadi ejen rahsia ditugaskan mencari penawar bagi virus zombi.

programme.title: Cik Misi 123
programme.desc: Oya menggunakan apa dipelajari selama ini membantu seorang pakcik yang cedera. Baby berkelakuan ganjil berjumpa dengan seorang pesakit yang merupakan novelis pujaannya. Oya mula melihat sisi baik Mika.

programme.title: The House Season 5 S5
programme.desc: Dulu bergaduh di pentas Bigstage. Sekarang, kena duduk serumah? Boleh ke Sarah Suhairi, Sissy Imann dan Wani Kayrie ni tahan dengan perangai masing-masing?

programme.title: Impiana S4
programme.desc: Kini Impiana lebih berarah kepada golongan Malaynial, dipenuhi dengan segmen yang penuh inspirasi bertujuan untuk dijadikan destinasi rujukan bagi penonton mencari idea untuk hiasan rumah mereka.

programme.title: Gelak Gempak Edisi Khas
programme.desc: Bersama Dato' Afdlin, Sherry & Joanne Kam sebagai juri dan barisan artis popular seperti Bell Ngasri, Tiz Zaqyah, Yasmin Aziz dan ramai lagi membuat standup comedy dalam Gelak Gempak Edisi Khas!

programme.title: Perang Periuk
programme.desc: Pelbagai drama dan cabaran yang harus mereka tempuhi. Bertemu dan beradu tenaga di dapur. Minggu ini Perang Periuk menampilkan Puan Tiya dan Puan Norly.

programme.title: Elok Now Rumah
programme.desc: Sebuah program televisyen yang memfokuskan kepada gaya hidup serta transformasi dan ubah suai kediaman.

programme.title: Cerai
programme.desc: Pengalaman berkurung dengan pasangan selama musim PKP memaksa dua pasangan suami isteri menilai semula perkahwinan mereka yang telah disalah ertikan selama ini.

programme.title: Halal Maps
programme.desc: Halal Maps relish the wonders of Jakarta the locals show us what their cultural palate brings to the table.

programme.title: Jangan
programme.desc: 12 selebriti dan pelawak ditugaskan untuk mengharungi cabaran yang menakutkan atas nama survival. Orang terakhir yang berjaya mengatasi semua cabaran akan memenangi hadiah wang tunai.

programme.title: Borak Hantu
programme.desc: Sebuah program baharu di Astro Ria, mengungkap kisah-kisah dan kejadian aneh yang berlaku.

programme.title: Aneh
programme.desc: Seorang lelaki berada dalam koma setelah kemalangan jalan raya dan dalam keadaan tidak sedar itu, dia meminta bantuan seorang wanita tentang jin yang mengganggu keluarganya.

programme.title: Syafiq Kyle & Mimi Lana : Bukan Honeymoon Cliche
programme.desc: Syafiq dan Mimi cuba elak gangguan Nik dalam bulan madu mereka, tapi setibanya di Kaherah, satu berita membuat Syafiq rasa bersalah untuk menolaknya.

programme.title: Food Psychology
programme.desc: Hidangan laut istimewa seperti abalon, sirip yu, perut ikan dan pelbagai makanan laut lain menjadi sajian tradisional masyarakat Cina. Selain lazat, ia juga dipercayai membantu meningkatkan daya tahan tubuh.

programme.title: Amazing Staycation - Lombok
programme.desc: Semi-dokumentari tentang percutian dan penginapan di Lombok, sebuah pulau yang indah di Indonesia.

programme.title: Take The Night
programme.desc: Sebuah kejutan hari jadi yang dirancang bertukar menjadi mimpi ngeri apabila penjenayah upahan yang sepatutnya melakonkan penculikan palsu mula bertindak di luar kawalan.

programme.title: Luar Biasa
programme.desc: Kisah yang diinspirasikan daripada pemenang pingat emas Paralimpik, Mohamad Ridzuan yang menghadapi penyakit 'Cebral Palsy' dan abangnya yang sentiasa ada di sisinya.

programme.title: This is My Generation
programme.desc: Golongan milenial sering dilabel sebagai mementingkan diri sendiri. Namun, program ini menampilkan kisah sebenar milenial inspirasi dari pelbagai bidang yang berjaya memecahkan stereotaip tersebut.

programme.title: The Ku Cin Show
programme.desc: Rancangan istimewa yang buat julung kalinya menampilkan bintang utama haiwan peliharaan kucing kesayangan di bawah jagaan dan seliaan artis dan selebriti popular.

programme.title: Living With My Manager
programme.desc: Living with My Manager mengikuti bakat baharu daripada Talk To My Manager Musim 2 yang tinggal bersama pengurus mereka yang juga merupakan ibu bapa sendiri. Di sebalik pentas yang glamor, program ini memaparkan realiti, konflik, dan emosi dalam perjalanan mereka mengejar impian.

programme.title: MeleTOP S14

programme.title: Best of The Week Big Stage Rocketfuel

programme.title: Biarin Aja Aku Cinta Kamu Selama Gak Makan Ternak Warga
programme.desc: Winda has been betrothed by her father to a man named Devan, but Winda refuses and chooses to run away from home. While on the way, the car driven by Winda accidentally hit a goat named Timmy, owned by Ikbal. As the leader of the group, Winda apologized for making Timmy an accident. Winda promised to be responsible. What is the next story?

programme.title: Kabarnya Sampai Saat Ini Mereka Masih Saling Sayang
programme.desc: Rahayu's prayer was immediately answered by God, she had just arrived when a rich husband who was going to marry her was named Nando. Nina was surprised to see Nina smirk at her.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: It tells the story of a girl named Sakinah who lives a life full of pressure due to slander and is forced to marry a person who does not love her. Not only that, Sakinah was even prevented from knowing who her biological mother had the heart to throw her away. How does Sakinah's life story continue?

programme.title: Mohon Doa Restu Yura, Semesta Mendukung
programme.desc: Syifa is a girl who is obsessed with getting into a favorite college, but her friends don't believe in Syifa's abilities. While Syifa's friend was insulting Syifa, suddenly a man named Bowo came to defend Syifa. Syifa asked Bowo to help her until Syifa could graduate from college, but the condition was that Syifa had to be willing to be Bowo's girlfriend for 3 months after Syifa was accepted to college. What is the next story?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir and Sukma are a simple yet happily married couple. Their happiness is tested when their child, Zahra, is diagnosed with a serious illness amidst their financial struggles. At the same time, Fathir unexpectedly runs into his ex-girlfriend, Clara, whose presence changes everything.

programme.title: Dari Wibu Jadi With You
programme.desc: Nita, wearing a Wibu costume under the alias Mona, is busking on the street, which disturbs Robby's peace. Robby then sprays the street musicians with water from a hose he is holding. Unexpectedly, Nita and Robby meet again on campus. Since Nita is not wearing her costume, Robby does not recognize her. Several events bring Nita and Robby closer, especially when they both become victims of their respective partners' infidelities.

programme.title: 我和我的父辈
My Country, My Parents
programme.desc: 电影由四个单元故事组成，分别由吴京章子怡徐峥沈腾执导及主演，以不同中国时代为背景，通过家与国为题，描写几代父辈的奋斗经历，讲述中国人的血脉相连和精神传承，再现中国人努力拼搏的时代记忆

programme.title: 逆鳞
Untouchable
programme.desc: 尊非投身黑白两道通吃的富商黄朝晋门下，成为其左右手他既要面对帮派厮杀与权力暗斗，还陷于人性的复杂博弈，更在情义与道义之间反复挣扎最终，他被迫卷入一场以生命为筹码的生死赌局

programme.title: 梅兰芳
Forever Enthralled
programme.desc: 电影改编自中国戏曲艺术大师梅兰芳的真人真事，讲述梅兰芳从少时到成名后的遭遇，当中他经历了无数困难和挑战，而其标志性的美国之旅更将传统京剧带到西方直至日本侵华期间，他才断然结束自己多年的职业生涯

programme.title: 秘密访客
Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: 一场惨烈的校车车祸，导致几乎全部学童丧生司机拼命救回一名男孩，却令自己失去部分记忆男孩的父亲为答救命之恩，把司机带到自家地下室里与他们共同生活司机渐渐发现这家人的行为诡秘，众人的异常更似乎与那场车祸有关

programme.title: 窗前明月，咣！
Out of Order
programme.desc: 顶级律师的秘密幽会，却因酒店房间里离奇出现的一具尸体，瞬间沦为无法回头的噩梦为了掩盖真相，他的每一步都让一切变得更加混乱

programme.title: 阿龙
Atonement
programme.desc: 阿龙与女儿相依为命，生活潦倒却依然乐观，深信好人有好报然而一次泰国之旅，女儿惨遭拐走信念崩塌的他为追寻线索不惜一切，暗中追查拐子集团，最终化身双手沾血的复仇者

programme.title: 猎金游戏
A Gilded Game
programme.desc: 野心勃勃的金融高材生高寒，适逢好友的家族企业正筹备在香港上市，因而被引荐进入投行实习在首席分析师张托德的带领下，高迅速崭露头角，却因野心作祟而背叛恩师，转投竞争对手当好友的家族企业被敌意收购时，为了弥补过失，高恳求张相助，连手阻止这场恶意收购

programme.title: 合家辣
Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: 新冠病毒疫情爆发，令Coba在家工作，成天与家人发生争执Coba决定将母亲的手工辣椒酱变成潮物，企图转移家人视线避免争吵Coba的父母和姑妈一起制作手工辣椒酱，并在社交平台上放售，其后辣椒酱大卖，成绩更令大家喜出望外

programme.title: 边缘行者
Man on the Edge
programme.desc: 1997年香港回归前夕，多方势力矛盾激化，黑帮暴力事件频生巨变当前，黑帮龙头委派亲信阿骆主理毒品生意，但原来阿骆是警方的卧底调查毒品案期间，他更揭发一场惊人的政治阴谋

programme.title: 出租家人
We are Family
programme.desc: 沉迷于演戏的临时演员志光，加入由家聪与立志成为女演员的佩怡一起成立的出租家人公司，变成出租临时家人当他们出演临时家人服务时，发现家庭成员间的复杂关系，并建立更深入的联系

programme.title: S风暴
S Storm
programme.desc: 廉政公署首席调查主任陆志廉在调查非法足球搏彩集团时目击嫌疑犯被杀重案组督察刘保强急需陆志廉的口供，但因廉署的保密守则，陆志廉无法提供任何线索，阻碍刘保强的调查二人由调查开始时的互不信任，到最后发展出默契，誓要将犯罪集团连根拔起

programme.title: 西游记之大闹天宫
The Monkey King
programme.desc: 女娲娘娘化成万千五彩晶石补天，其中一颗晶石迸出了孙悟空孙悟空武功高强，不知天高地厚竟挑战玉皇大帝，搞得天宫一片混乱，无意间让牛魔王乘虚而入，欲攻陷天宫重振魔族声威

programme.title: 全城地图：最强明星队
The Best Team
programme.desc: 全城地图：最强明星队是一运动竞技实境节目，由钱薇娟与江宏杰分别领军蓝红两队，以城市为竞技场，穿梭全台进行团队对抗该节目以将城市化为竞技场为概念，集结好手争夺最强明星队荣耀The Best Team is a sports reality competition programme where Taiwan national athletes and celebrities take part in Blue and Red teams respectively, using cities as their battlegrounds, travelling across Taiwan and compete against one another. Based on the concept of turning cities into arenas, the programme brings together top athletes to vie for the title of the ultimate celebrity team.

programme.title: 型男大主厨
Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earth's fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeon's internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Deploy biochemical weaponry with nature's most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bow down to one of nature's most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

programme.title: In for the Kill
programme.desc: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 1
programme.desc: From the Highlands to the Alps, Europe's evocative landscapes are the backdrop for epic wildlife drama. Normally stoic red deer go wild during the rut. Wolf packs clash over territory, and foxes do the foxtrot - it's not as nice as it sounds.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks Season 1

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1
programme.desc: Circle the equator for a look at the diverse species that dwell in tropical forests. Meet a lone sloth growing a mini-forest, lemurs that share and share alike, and elephants that tend to their woodland gardens. Then explore the region's dark side.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1
programme.desc: Watch the seasons wax and wane and learn how trees and animals help one another survive. Witness spring fireflies dancing after dark, discover summer fungi that cool off overheated trees, and prep for autumn migrations as the leaves begin to fall.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1
programme.desc: Wade into wetlands, where trees and water meet to nurture new life. Dive into an underwater forest that protects young fur seals, visit a mangrove sanctuary where a curious band of aquatic misfits hides out, and meet some real-life swamp monsters.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1
programme.desc: Climb into a realm of thin air and towering rock. Tag along as mythical monkeys battle for a winter food stash, sing along with lemurs in a fruit-filled tree canopy, and watch an aromatic tree bring together blossom and possum in a moonlit tryst.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1
programme.desc: Travel to the Arctic for a peek at the brutal challenges of life in the boreal forest, then admire some stellar animal adaptations. Witness a secret reindeer superpower, navigate a rodent labyrinth of snow, and learn why moose are gourmets at heart.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Forests Season 1

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue Season 1
programme.desc: Join the vet and his team in saving a massive sea lion caught in a plastic noose, and then visit the Rescue Center, where a harbor seal pup may lose its eyesight and a baby sea otter needs a risky but life-saving surgery.

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue Season 1
programme.desc: Battle wind and waves to find a sea lion trapped in a plastic ring. Then visit the rescue center, where over 80 orphan seals must be fed several times a day to prepare for release into the wild, and see an Amazonian duck get a miraculous operation.

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue Season 1
programme.desc: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

programme.title: Over Australia Season 1
programme.desc: From the vast, dry plains of the interior come some of Australia's most recognized imagery, such as the monolithic red rock of Uluru and the bounding red kangaroo. But how did the arid center of the continent come to be?

programme.title: Over Australia Season 1
programme.desc: Created by titanic forces and spanning 3,700 km along the eastern edge of Australia, the Great Dividing Range separates two very different worlds. Aerial footage and intimate studies reveal how species survive and thrive in this mountain home.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard that's chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2

And why are they all back in spring?

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1

What is it that makes them so successful?

However, their marriage is not as smooth as it seems. The presence of Lia, Rossa's best friend, becomes a thorn in the relationship between Rossa and Alvino. To make m...

programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 137
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family's debts. However, fate brings her together with Pasha, a respectable man from a wealthy family. Unbeknownst to them, they were actually switched at birth. What will happen to Adisty and Pasha's lives?

programme.title: CAHAYA TERINDAH EPS 103
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Indah (Ranty Maria) and her struggle to find her biological family after discovering that she was adopted. She runs away to Jakarta from her adoptive father (Jamal), who intends to sell her, and ends up working for the Hendardi family, where she faces romantic conflicts and emotional mysteries from her past.

programme.title: TERIKAT JANJI EPS 59
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Davina, a conglomerate's daughter who falls into poverty after being betrayed. She is forced to pretend to be in a relationship with Sena, a ketoprak street vendor. This fake relationship, meant to protect her reputation, becomes complicated when Sena is actually an undercover intelligence agent on a mission tied to his pastfurther intensified by conflicts involving a stepmother and past betrayals.

programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 59
programme.desc: Albi (Samuel Zylgwyn) is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza (Rachquel Nesia), at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia (Faradilla Yoshi), Albi's wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: MAHLIGAI UNTUK CINTA 14
programme.desc: Ridho is a simple man from a village who is matched with Mutia, a young woman who shares a similar background. They are close friends with Putri, the daughter of a wealthy family who owns a vegetable company. Their friendship is filled with warmth and happiness, until a major conflict strikes Putri and her family.

programme.title: 他从火光中走来

programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

Bright Eyes in the Dark

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard that's chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Engage in a battle of wills with Adele and Mick as they try to coax a python out of a drainpipe. Stand by as Jess and Dan try to grab a keelback snake before it drops a stink bomb, then face a dangerous serpent hidden in a university wall with Stu.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Kick back as Mick and Adele break up a pair of mating eastern brown snakes at a retirement home. Take care of unwanted inventory with Stu and Liv, who capture a green tree snake in a warehouse, then sneak up on a killer visitor with Jess and Dan.

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1
programme.desc: As soon as the days get cold and dark insects begin to disappear from the meadows and fields. Their sum and hum slowly fades away and will finally be gone. All animals have their special ways to survive winter. Migrating birds like swallows and cranes fly towards south, a lot of mammals like deer get a thick winter fur or hide away and sleep where it's warm. But what do insects do? And why are they all back in spring?

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1
programme.desc: It is horror! It is murder! Brutal death as well as exciting fights with an exceptional last-minute rescue. And after seeing it you will know the creepiest spot is actually the meadow in your neighborhood. With stylistic devices from the horror genre this extraordinary nature documentary takes you on a journey following a well-known hero with six legs, red wings and seven black dots through a seemingly normal meadow but full of monsters.

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1
programme.desc: Beetles have inhabited the Earth for more than 240 million years. There are around 380,000 kinds of beetles known to scientists and every year hundreds of new species are discovered. One fourth of the world's animals are beetles. They have conquered almost every corner and every habitat on the planet and they have survived every global disaster. What is it that makes them so successful?

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 1
programme.desc: Wildebeest battle for herd hierarchy, meerkats live the thug life, floppy fish fight it out on land and locusts give up their vegetarian ways in a frenzy of cannibalism. It all happens on the wild and wide-open landscape of South Africa.

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australia's Ocean Wonder Season 1
programme.desc: Observe the natural and human forces that have shaped Ningaloo Reef, Cape Range, and Exmouth Gulf with Tim, Traditional Owners, and other experts. Check out a million-year-old fossil reef, a gargantuan fish, and a ray that packs quite a punch.

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australia's Ocean Wonder Season 1
programme.desc: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloo's biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeon's internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

programme.title: Animals Like Us Season 1
programme.desc: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness' flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters' club.

programme.title: Animals Like Us Season 1
programme.desc: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephant's secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild Season 2
programme.desc: Test limits with jaguar cub Frida, who's honing her survival skills in Brazil's Caiman Lodge Reserve. Learn how to sneak with mum Gatuna, see sister Anouk help her hide from hungry interlopers, and go on a reckless solo trek that takes a lucky turn.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffe's demise becomes a source of life for the region's vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

programme.title: 極限挑戰 第十季
Go Fighting! Season 10 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 極挑團原班人馬將與新成員一起解鎖更多挑戰，他們將與廣大觀眾一起跨越大江南北，體驗國民生活百態，用真心探訪這片古老土地上正在發生的溫情故事，以更豐富的視角觸摸這卷山河下每一位個體的對美好生活的深切期望

programme.title: 我們的歌 第六季
Singing With Legends Season 6 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 節目煥新升級，打破原有賽制，以聽世界的聲音，唱我們的歌為主題，廣邀了劉宇寧毛不易馬嘉祺古巨基李克勤騰格爾龔琳娜等三十多位歌手平行演繹，回歸音樂本質，共同打造融合金曲，為歌手之間的合作與交流提供更多的可能性，打造充滿無限活力的音樂盛宴

programme.title: 點贊！達人秀
Talent
programme.desc: 全民才藝真人秀節目，圍繞主題聚焦不同類型達人進行同主題表演；邀請了謝霆鋒鄧紫棋孟非伊能靜組成觀察團，從各自的專業知識與觀察視角出發，深入百姓生活，挖掘值得點贊的才藝與故事

programme.title: 遊遍江蘇 第4季
Travel through Jiangsu Season 4
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力

programme.title: 音你而來第3季
The Melody of You Season 3
programme.desc: 音樂+旅行+社交的唱演真人秀，由王赫野王琳凱張碧晨三位老友攜手劉雨昕周震南姚曉棠容祖兒等多位新朋友，跟隨音你小隊開啟全新的集體旅居生活；音樂人將在絕美的自然風光中尋找創作靈感，通過音樂與當地人產生連接與互動，帶來一場充滿人情味的治療音樂之旅

programme.title: 姐姐當家 第2季
Her Prime Season 2
programme.desc: 以姐姐當家，愛是什麼為主題，集結杜華房主任冉瑩穎小鹿徐夢桃五位當家姐姐，以更加豐富的人生樣本回應當代女性共同面對的生活課題；觀察團成員李維嘉倪萍倪子君張泉靈回歸，共同組成多元觀察體系，從專業視角與大眾視角出發，共同尋找愛是什麼的答案

programme.title: 江蘇衛視2017跨年演唱會
2016-2017 Jiangsu Count Down Concert
programme.desc: 李克勤搭檔容祖兒，動感舞曲high翻全場；林宥嘉輕吟淺唱苦情歌，催人淚下；林俊傑獻唱歌曲串燒，引發全場大合唱；還有潘瑋柏李宗盛吳亦凡蔡依林李宇春陳偉霆等群星雲集，帶來無與倫比的視聽盛宴!

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
Love Never Comes Late Season 4
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃 第2季
Crush of Music Season 2 (Repackaged)
programme.desc: 將繼續以音樂牽線，緣分發聲為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深薛之謙單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台！

programme.title: 百姓的味道
People's Palate
programme.desc: 美食紀錄類真人秀，由謝霆鋒擔任美食尋味官，與嘉賓一起探尋領略各地風土人情壯麗山河，品嘗民間百味；在野趣橫生的自然和充滿煙火氣的城市中，尋覓中國百姓生活，解讀百味人生

programme.title: 姐姐當家 第2季
Her Prime Season 2

programme.title: 一夢如初(短劇)
A Dream LikeTheTrue Love (Mini drama)

programme.title: 黑月光法則(短劇)
Princess Revenge(Mini drama)
programme.desc: 名門千金東方曦為愛隱姓埋名打工供養男友，慘遭背叛後覺醒，竟發現自己身處小說世界，成了注定悲劇的惡毒女配；為了改寫命運，她與系統達成賭約，不僅當眾揭穿了渣男的真面目，更發現暗中守護自己的大哥竟是系統化身這是一場關於覺醒反殺與破局的奇幻愛戀，挑戰傳統的黑月光法則

programme.title: 火星情報局 第7季

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.title: 翘楚
Ashes to Crown
programme.desc: 将军之女楚朝为改变自己成为楚国世子萧珣夺权路上牺牲品的可悲命运，发现主动出击才是改变命运的唯一途径在与命运一波三折的对抗中，她与谢家庶子谢燕来相识，并点亮了谢燕来原本灰暗的人生，助谢燕来挣脱命运枷锁，从禁军小卒成长为镇国大将军楚朝与谢燕来合力成功阻止了世子的野心和计划，在本该逃离是非之地的途中，见到战火中百姓的苦难，楚朝毅然返回城内，助力小皇孙萧羽为帝，直至萧羽亲政然而萧珣又引外敌来犯，为权欲不惜陷万民于水火楚朝携手谢燕来与之殊死抵抗，领军浴血奋战，终于成功解除大楚内忧外患至此，楚朝不仅改变了自己的命运，也让大楚千千万万百姓摆脱了战火离乱的颠沛命运Reborn before her fateful marriage, General's daughter Chu Chao vows to avert her family's tragic doom. programme.title: 绝命法官
Justice Is Mine
programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.desc: 王权富贵是王权弘业和东方淮竹的儿子，是王权世家实力最强者被家族作为道门兵人培养的王权富贵，生活没有自由，而清瞳本来是毒娘子安排到王权家打听情报的间谍，和王权富贵结识后，在富贵的帮助下恢复了自由同时王权富贵内心渴望自由憧憬天下大同的信念亦被逐渐点燃，经历万剑穿心，王权富贵带着清瞳离开王权山庄，走上了自己所悟之道Wang Quan Fu Gui is the son of Wang Quan Hong Ye and Dongfang Huai Zhu, and the most powerful member of the Wang Quan family. Trained as a Daoist soldier, Fu Gui lived a life without freedom. programme.title: 奔跑吧特别篇 5
Keep Running Special Season 5
programme.desc: 奔跑吧特别篇 5着重于中国一些偏远和少为人知的地点城市，通过创新游戏设置，增加艺人与当地民众的互动，同时激发大众对奔跑的渴望对温暖的传递和对美好的追求，以综艺化的特色表达传递正能量节目还是由奔跑吧固定MC班底 - 超人气大卡艺人继续担纲主持任务

Parallel World

programme.title: 灼灼韶华
Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人重诺守信的女商人This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.title: 大泼猴
The Legends Of Monkey King
programme.desc: 天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 现在很美丽
It's Beautiful Now
programme.desc: 此剧讲述在回避恋爱和结婚的时代，李家三兄弟为了占据家庭长辈们留给他们的公寓而寻找伴侣的故事李庆哲是李家的祖父和精神领袖，年纪轻轻就成了鳏夫 在他最低谷的时候，收养了旻昊 与庆哲一样，旻昊和妻子都寄望于他们三个长大成人的儿子，三个体面的年轻人，都有一份不错的工作 庆哲向他的孙子们提出了一个提议， 第一个结婚的人会得到一套公寓 贤才是三个男孩中的第二个，是一名律师 润才是一位在该地区享有盛誉的牙医 秀才一边在包裹服务公司工作，一边为公务员考试做准备 三兄弟谁先结婚？

programme.desc: 著名女演员朴道萝个性独特，她之所以成为演员，是因为母亲告诉她，这是脱离贫穷的唯一方法透过成名而得到人气和金钱，道萝心底却希望可以休息，可是母亲却一直闯祸挥霍生活，还贪图更多母亲的欲望令道萝开始承受不了繁忙的工作，打算放弃参与新剧就在这时，她遇上了初恋高必胜，也就是新剧的副导演必胜对于工作充满热情，但因为道萝而决定放弃新剧一次意外让道萝掉进必胜怀里，两人的人生从此再次连上Top actress Park Do Ra rose to fame at her mother Baek Mi Ja's urge to escape poverty. programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.title: 绝命法官
Justice Is Mine
programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.title: 白色橄榄树
The White Olive Tree
programme.desc: 梁城卫视女记者宋冉在动荡的东国执行采访任务时突遇危险，所幸被在东国做志愿者的华裔爆破工程师李瓒相救，李瓒的温柔和心怀大爱的赤子之心深深吸引了宋冉李瓒在与宋冉的多次相处中，也发现这个女孩外表看似柔弱，其实勇敢坚强，内心充满了正义与善良相同的理想和契合的灵魂，让两人擦出了爱的火花然而，一场突发的爆炸袭击将这份刚刚萌生的感情画上了休止符回国后的两人都陷入了人生的低谷，甚至彼此失去了联系李瓒因为好友在爆炸袭击中为救自己而牺牲感到内疚自责，宋冉则由于在爆炸袭击中拍摄的一张照片而备受争议，两人都承受着身心的双重伤痛机缘巧合下他们重逢，渐渐各自的生活走回了正轨，他们一起种下了白色橄榄树种子

programme.title: 绝命法官
Justice Is Mine
programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the region's species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the city's shrinking wetlands.

programme.title: Animals Like Us Season 1
programme.desc: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness' flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters' club.

programme.title: Animals Like Us Season 1
programme.desc: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephant's secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Engage in a battle of wills with Adele and Mick as they try to coax a python out of a drainpipe. Stand by as Jess and Dan try to grab a keelback snake before it drops a stink bomb, then face a dangerous serpent hidden in a university wall with Stu.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Kick back as Mick and Adele break up a pair of mating eastern brown snakes at a retirement home. Take care of unwanted inventory with Stu and Liv, who capture a green tree snake in a warehouse, then sneak up on a killer visitor with Jess and Dan.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon Season 1
programme.desc: How many trees can you find in the Amazon? And what's it like to live up in them? Travel through the canopy and see how more than 1200 species of trees coexist. Plus, follow monkeys and other creatures who call these trees home.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon Season 1
programme.desc: The dry season is the toughest time of year. With lower water levels and less space, animals need to quickly learn new skills to surviveand if they don't, predatory vultures will swoop in for a feast.

programme.title: Strange Creatures Season 2
programme.desc: Keep your distance from these natural-born killers. Armed with venom and other poisonous tools that make hunting easier (and escape impossible), nudibranches, cuttlefish, giant centipedes, and assassin bugs are all dressed to kill.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon Season 1

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bow down to one of nature's most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: A Wild Year on Earth Season 1
programme.desc: In the early months of the year, the Earth's axial tilt brings the height of summer in some places and the depths of winter in others. See how life struggles to survive under these extreme conditions.

programme.title: A Wild Year on Earth Season 1
programme.desc: Travel around the globe to witness the atmospheric shifts that take place in March, from the wave of cherry blossoms that unfold across Japan to the final raft of green sea turtles that arrive on the Great Barrier Reef islands to lay eggs.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild Season 2
programme.desc: Feel the enchantment of Brazil's Atlantic Forest as southern muriqui Dora takes her first steps away from mum Mimi. Get lessons in spider monkey troop dynamics, bone up on tail-hanging technique, and see this baby find her place among her peers.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1
programme.desc: As soon as the days get cold and dark insects begin to disappear from the meadows and fields. Their sum and hum slowly fades away and will finally be gone. All animals have their special ways to survive winter. Migrating birds like swallows and cranes fly towards south, a lot of mammals like deer get a thick winter fur or hide away and sleep where it's warm. But what do insects do? And why are they all back in spring?

programme.desc: World Insight with Tian Wei is a long-running international platform for debate and intelligent discussion. It is the meeting point of both the highly influential and rising voices, facilitated by host, Tian Wei. Every Monday to Friday, it provides nutrition to form your own thoughts and ideas through live debate and interviews. Live debates linking movers and shakers take place in the signature segment Global Debate. It features a diversity of perspectives and insights on the most important g

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the worlds top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: The Vibe
programme.desc: The Vibe is a 30-minute TV show that runs daily on weekdays on CGTN. The content focuses on exciting new trends, fashion, and cultural topics across a range of disciplines both in China and abroad. The host presents various culture-related topics in a fun way while also doing some in-depth analysis to give viewers a fuller picture as to what is happening, and why it matters.

programme.desc: Suddenly, Yogi's (Ridho Illahi) life became colorful because of the arrival of a new physical education teacher at his school named Wina (Nabila Zavira). Yogi wanted to join in the sports activities when Wina was training her students. However, Wina says, Strength doesn't just come from Yogi's physical abilities, but also from a strong mind and heart. Yogi is captivated by what Wina says. But later, it turns out that Wina ends up accepting another guy's love, leaving Yogi heartbroken.

programme.desc: Ranti (Larasati Nugroho) adalah pekerja keras dan selalu ceria menghadapi hari-harinya. Ranti kemudian tanpa sengaja menabrak seorang laki-laki tampan bernama Rain (Cakrawala Airawan). Diceritakan kalau Rain sedang mengejar waktu, dengan membawa cincin untuk melamar kasihnya yang bernama Vivi pada hari itu. Rain pun kehilangan cincin, gara-gara tabrakan atau insiden bersama penjula kopi cantik alias Ranti.
